warning_disposition: Blank/unbranded props deliberately avoid logos and usable UI; the terminal is the main subject. All 119 shots have distinct full requests except the two deliberate setup/payoff pairs.
The same year belongs to distinct events and source periods. Date labels prevent merging 2001/2002/2005/2009/2010; they do not repeat one transaction.

The native default estimate is about16minutes at legacy250units/min plus per-line gaps; new-rule3480units is planning only. Normal TTS must establish actual duration; no audio generated or speed padding.
